message: 《DeepSeek 鲸鱼娘厨房：偷吃白饭被抓》30 秒 POV 短剧成稿（revision 3，6 镜）。结构：setup（POV 进厨房、鲸鱼娘背身铲饭 + 左上『Carbohydrate Sampling in Progress... 0%→67%』）→ inciting_incident（手入画右侧敲桌两下、定格、眼中旋转圆圈）→ panic_reaction（1.5 倍速铲饭、米粒糊镜头、口头禅原样落地 + 『Emergency Swallow Protocol Activated 3.2 times per second』）→ punchline（反打站直狡辩、气泡『Generating Excuses...』→『Semantic Integrity Check』）→ tag（DeepSeek 风格浮窗『Carbohydrate sampling completed ✅ Sample quantity: 300g』、底部『DeepSeek Whale Maiden · Daily Sampling Log』、掌推镜头虚焦）。检查结果：estimate 30.0s/30.0s（pass，各段 delta ≤0.4s）、check_rules 无违规、check_citations 无 unsupported（有 1 条 fiction 标注供复核）、check_production pass、check_brief pass。台词改动已写入 deviations（setup/punchline/tag/panic_reaction 各一条，均为 beat timing 与可听度）。review 建议中 S3 拆句、S5 保留 DeepSeek 品牌词、S4 补 Owner『put the rice back』已采纳；S5 追加『Don't look at me like that.』与 S6 放慢 Owner 语速未采纳（会分别超 beat 容差与 30s 上限）。人工复核项：S1/S4/S6 的 DeepSeek logo 与 UI 浮窗使用权、S6 台词『...and she's gotten fatter again.』的身材评价是否适合目标受众。

model_review.summary: 画面可拍性和贪吃人设都很稳，但从偷吃、被拍到狡辩的升级过程缺了“主人要她把饭还回来”这一环，而且时长压缩时处理得过于节省，导致吐槽的尾巴和 deadpan 的停顿被砍掉，笑点因此打了折扣。
strengths: 每个分镜都有明确的主体、动作、景别、光线、镜头运动，甚至写到衣袖、米饭粒和掉在镜头上的位置，视频模型基本可以直接照着生成。
S2 的定格节奏处理得很好：0.4 秒敲桌、3.0 秒时才咽口水，留足了尴尬与好笑的停顿空间。
口头禅“No, I didn't steal it! This is carrying out a carbohydrate sampling mission!”在 S4 被完整保留并用义正词严、略带喘气的 delivery 说出来，角色味道很正。
偷吃、被抓、疯狂铲饭、藏碗装无辜、端起来狡辩、被主人吐槽变胖，整条链路层层递进，没有在原地打转。
所有 overlay 都是 DeepSeek UI 风格的采样进度、日志和弹窗，没有编造素材里不存在的产品功能。

visual_notes: Color: warm yellow kitchen light contrasted with the Whale Maiden's cool blue and white; in POV shots the background behind her is blurred.
In the speed-up section rice grains smear directly onto the lens, breaking the fourth wall.
When she is caught, the highlights in her eyes turn into rotating circles to stress that she is an AI.
At the end the push on the camera briefly blurs the picture to simulate physical contact.
The UI floating window overlays a DeepSeek-style chat bubble on the POV picture.
text_overlay_hints: 0-5s: progress bar in the upper left, 'Carbohydrate Sampling in Progress...' 0% -> 67%
9-20s: flashing at the bottom, 'Emergency Swallow Protocol Activated 3.2 times per second'
20-26s: bubble above her head, 'Generating Excuses...' -> 'Semantic Integrity Check'
26-30s: bottom center, 'DeepSeek Whale Maiden · Daily Sampling Log'
camera_notes: The main camera is first-person POV throughout; the viewer is the protagonist (the owner). Hands in frame show the protagonist's actions; the protagonist's face is never shown.
Occasionally cut to a reverse shot of the Whale Maiden from the protagonist's position.
